purpose: Reusable fact fields for Rugspull lifecycle artifacts. This file is a template, not evidence of any Rug.
globalBoundaries: Label TESTNET and MAINNET materials explicitly and never combine their counts.
Use full addresses, transaction hashes, block numbers, UTC timestamps, raw integer amounts, and display-unit amounts.
State the creator/project relationship and stake source when Rugspull or a collaborator controls the creator wallet.
Project-authored tests, source verification, indexer output, and TESTNET flows are not an independent audit or safety finding.
Do not call a lifecycle settled unless every eligible contributor claim or refund and every eligible creator withdrawal is evidenced.
Total loss remains possible. No artifact is a recommendation, endorsement, price claim, or request to transact.

requiredStatements: Opening is still in progress; no Failed or Active result is implied.
The creator cannot cancel after Opening starts.
If Active, the protocol-held Founder Allocation remains locked until the published unlock time and may later be sold once in full.
Failed creates no RugToken or RugPool.
Contributors claim their own recorded contributions; the Worker does not refund on their behalf.
The creation fee is not refunded.
Active is not Rugged and does not imply that every eligible contributor has claimed.
The canonical pool has no reserve-withdraw path, but trading still carries slippage, MEV, alternative-pool, and total-loss risk.
The founder sell is optional and has no forced deadline.
No Rugged event was observed by the stated cutoff; this is not a promise about future creator behavior.
The report cutoff is not a protocol deadline.
Do not pressure, reward, or provoke the creator to execute rug() for content.
Rugged means the protocol-held Founder Allocation was sold once in full; it is not a liquidity-reserve withdrawal.
Canonical trading may continue and no refund right is created by Rugged.
Do not describe claims as settled while any eligible contribution remains outstanding.
